title: 送98人上太空：却要暂停载人飞行，为了月球？
speaker: Dave Lim

segments.en: Yeah. You know, we were able to fly 98 people above the carbon line.
segments.zh: 是的。你知道，我们成功让98人飞越了卡门线。

segments.en: I've never seen so many smiles on every astronaut that we were able to do that for.
segments.zh: 我从未见过每位宇航员脸上都洋溢着如此多的笑容。

segments.en: And I think if you had to make the decision to put New Shepherd on pause, we put on pause for at least two years, with your heart, it would have been a very hard decision.
segments.zh: 我认为，如果凭感情做决定，暂停新谢泼德至少两年会是一个非常艰难的决定。

segments.en: You see that you saw it when you saw Jeff fly. Every customer is the happiest customer you've ever seen.
segments.zh: 当你看到杰夫飞行时，你就明白了。每位客户都是你见过的最快乐的客户。

segments.en: But when you make that decision with your head, it was probably one of the simpler business decisions that Jeff had ever made because I am so passionate about getting the U.S. back to the moon.
segments.zh: 但当你用理智做决定时，这可能是杰夫做过的最简单的商业决策之一，因为我非常热衷于让美国重返月球。

segments.en: As is Jeff. I don't think the country wants another sputnik moment.
segments.zh: 杰夫也是如此。我认为这个国家不希望再经历一次斯普特尼克时刻。

segments.en: We have been saying it blue for 20 plus years that the moon is this incredible gift given to us.
segments.zh: 20多年来，我们一直强调，月球是赐予我们的不可思议的礼物。
它距离我们只有三天的路程。
